The service, distribution and reference block precedes two centered notice headings and a separate decorative row. Labelled candidate, title, defense, director and laboratory fields lead into three abstract paragraphs, the duration and a five-name jury. A delegated-signatory block occupies the lower right; the compact pen signature lies below its left portion, with a separate underlined typed name further down. A pale handwritten number stands at the extreme lower left. The count is 36 typed rows, including two decorative rows, one signature region and one marginal-number row; L01–L38 below follow this reading order.
legibility: The type is dark and generally distinct, including the full names, capitalization, dates, abbreviation punctuation and unusual printed mésure with its acute accent. A horizontal fold crosses the second abstract paragraph without hiding its letters. At the end of the opening title word, the e and s have complete visible contours but overlap because s is shifted left by about half a typewriter cell; the ink does not establish cancellation. Both letters are retained, with a small negative kern and a local unsure marker for their state. The signature's narrow upper loop, left appendage, low oval, long horizontal sweep and short lower rule can be reconstructed, while the alphabetic sequence remains unresolved. The light lower-left 11 is legible. Witness C agrees closely with the typed wording, including mésure, REGNIER J without a final point and FRANCOIS without an added initial. Its material omissions concern the separate keyed row and the signature's page-specific contours. C does not mark the crowded title ending's state. No witness H is supplied, so no H-error count is made.

notes: Source account: L05 dates this Montpellier notice to 14 octobre 1983 and L08 gives N° 4470 with MA/gs. L09–L19 announce a doctor-engineer thesis defense for GOUDEAU Jacques under the quoted subject PHYSIQUE DES MATERIAUX. The written thesis title concerns thermal-quenching stresses in pieces with rotational symmetry; its crowded final e/s pair in Contraintes remains locally marked. L15–L16 give Le 28 octobre 1983, à 11 heures and the Salle de l'IREM, followed by the full university name. The director field names M. ZARZYCKI - M. MAISONNEUVE; the laboratory field is retained with its source capitalization and punctuated U.S.T.L. L20–L26 state that temperature and stress fields are studied in a glass piece with rotational symmetry, that a thermovisco-élasticité problem is treated by finite elements with a MAXWELL-type behavior law whose coefficients vary with temperature, and that obtained results are compared with an optical method and an industrial method. These are the notice's statements, not results checked by this reader. The printed mésure retains its acute. L27 gives 2 ans; L28–L32 preserve the proposed jury, including REGNIER J without a final point and FRANCOIS without a supplied initial. L33–L37 contain the delegated-signatory wording, a graphically transcribed uncertain signature, and the separate typed A. GENTIL. L38 is the lighter marginal 11. The whole scan and each supplied half were viewed once, and all seven saved tight crops were inspected. The two isolated southeast footer dots at [1038,1926,1068,1950] were inspected on footer_marks; they have no textual or signature attachment and are omitted as specks, with no punctuation assigned. Every ordinary word, accent, abbreviation, name, punctuation mark, underline and printed numerical item was checked against the page. All required source material is included; there is no H witness and no supplied C/H difference row. No OCR, external research, second-reading crop, TeX compilation or mathematical verification was performed.
